entries.en: The geth certainly aren't subtle. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
They appear to have grappled through some sort of containment lab.
Seems like a containment lab of sorts, Commander.
Maybe we can swat it off. One of these claws has to have a weak spot.
Perhaps it can be dislodged. One of the other claws may have a weakness we have yet to detect.
Could the ship be dislodged? Maybe there's a flaw in one of the other claws we could exploit.
We need a way to give it a kick. Let's check the other claws. Damned things can't be perfect.
It will be difficult. We can check the other claws for weaknesses, but the geth are very thorough.
Subtle as a boot to the face. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
Indelicate, perhaps, but very efficient. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
The geth don't waste much finessing their landings. How do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
I like their docking style, but how do we cut the power if it's coming from the ship?
Same as before. We don't have the ordnance to blow this claw. Let's keep looking.
Same as before. We don't have the ordnance to blow this claw. Let's keep looking.
Just like the other one. We don't have the teeth to tear this out. Keep looking.
I fear we do not have the needed gear to destroy this claw. We will have to keep looking.
This claw is identical to the last. We'll have to keep going.
This is interesting, Shepard. A containment lab of some kind.
We find a way to break even one claw and that ship is out of here.
Whatever. We just need to find a way to break even one claw and that ship is out of here.
It is an asset we lacked at the other claws. Dislodge even one claw and that ship will fall.
It may be helpful. If we can dislodge even one claw the ship may fall.
It's no armory, but tear up even one claw and that ship is gone.
What do you make of this, Commander? Looks like a containment lab.
What is this, Commander? A containment lab?
Not much force across the whole system. Is there some way to isolate it on a single door?
Pretty weak across the whole system. Any way to isolate it on a single door?
Weak as hell across the whole system. Can we isolate it on a single door?
Force is dissipated across the whole system. Perhaps it can be concentrated?
It seems that force is dissipated across the system. Perhaps there is a way to isolate it?
Very good! The field barring the exit will be down. Now we can go deal with this Thorian creature.
All right! The door out will be open now. We can head back and deal with this Thorian thing.
That's the way. Doors will be open now. We can go deal with that Thorian thing.
Well done! Our way out should be clear now. We can go address this Thorian issue.
Exceptional, Commander! The fields will be down. We can go deal with this Thorian creature now.
The geth use these claws to anchor their ships to the sides of buildings.
Looks like they're using these claws to anchor that ship to the side of the building.
The geth must have anchored their ship to the side of the building with these claws.
It appears the geth are using these claws to anchor their ship to the side of the building.
The geth have anchored their ship to the building with these claws.
This was my kind of mission. Kill a bunch of geth, and end things off with a huge crash!
Damn. I'd like to have seen the face on their pilot when that thing toppled.
I hope that ship was full of those geth bastards!
Well. That got the job done.
Keep your guard up. There still might be a few geth inside the base.
I repeat, Normandy to shore party. Are you reading? Anyone there? Normandy to shore party. Come on, Commander, talk to me!
We're in lockdown here, Commander. Something happened to the colonists. They're banging on the hull, trying to claw their way inside the ship. They're freaking out!
Uh... yeah. Okay. Well, we'll just wait right here for you, Commander.
Uh... will do, Commander. We'll fire off a few warning shots. That should send them running.
Is that you, Joker? What's going on over there?
They can't do any real damage. We're on our way back. Just hold your position.
Keep those colonists away from the Normandy. Gun them down if you have to.
We're leaving, but let's rid this place of those damn synthetics before we go.
All right people, you know the drill. Let's move out.
This place will be crawling with geth in a minute. Keep together and we'll get out of here in one piece.
This is shore party.
Joker?
Sit tight.
Don't panic.
Protect the ship at all costs!
This is going to be fun!
We can't stay here.
Everyone stay close.
